version.changelog: v3.0.1: Security & Privacy Hardening - Added PRIVACY.md, consent gates for evolution memory write/read, privacy notices

llm.summary: This skill is a prompt-writing assistant for Jimeng image and video generation, with disclosed local preference memory but some activation and documentation rough edges.

dimensions.detail: The instructions are coherent with the stated purpose: routing Jimeng image/video requests, asking clarifying questions, producing prompts, and giving workflow guidance for reference assets.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Some trigger phrases are broad, including a standalone Jimeng mention and generic image/video creation phrases, so the skill could activate in loosely related creative conversations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown files only; no executable scripts, package install hooks, or hidden runtime mechanisms were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill says it does not make external network requests and its guidance is limited to conversational prompt generation plus user-directed use of Jimeng or related tools.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It uses a local references/evolution-memory.md file for cross-session visual preferences and says writes require consent, but the referenced memory file still says entries are automatically appended and the claimed PRIVACY.md file is not present in the packaged artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Safe to install if you want a Jimeng prompt assistant, but be aware it may remember local visual preferences after consent. Review or clear references/evolution-memory.md if you do not want cross-session personalization, and the publisher should add the missing PRIVACY.md and align the memory file text with the consent-gated behavior.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger phrases are relevant to a prompt-generation skill but should be narrowed because accidental activation could combine with local preference memory.
[SQP-1] expected: The standalone 即梦 trigger is understandable for this product-specific skill, but it is ambiguous and may activate when the user is only discussing the product.
